items.action: Write the workspace file mm2/mm2.properties for one dedicated MM2 process with two flows. Common settings: clusters=redpanda,kafka; redpanda.bootstrap.servers=redpanda:29092; kafka.bootstrap.servers=kafka:29092; replication.policy.class=org.apache.kafka.connect.mirror.IdentityReplicationPolicy; replication.factor=1 and every internal-topic replication factor 1; emit.heartbeats.enabled=false; sync.topic.acls.enabled=false; sync.topic.configs.enabled=false. Flow redpanda->kafka: topics=tenant\.tenant\.events; groups=ecommerce-catalog-service|ecommerce-image-service; emit.checkpoints.enabled=true; sync.group.offsets.enabled=true; interval 10s; offset-syncs.topic.location=target. No topic is in both allow-lists.

evidence.reference: Identity policy keeps the topic names the services and remaining consumers already use. Disjoint allow-lists prevent loops, which identity policy cannot detect.
